name: fable write
description: Proposal. echo write in Fable's marks: the creature steps two cells left and a one cell cursor types three lines of 1 cell text on a small page beside it, 450 ms a character; the four sideways eyes rest in pairs on the empty page and close ranks to the right to watch the text, a blink over the full page, then the page clears as the antenna pings; judge whether the closed ranks line reads as looking at the page.
